name: Goodreads Open Graph social card by goodreads.com
description: A restrained 1200×630 social card built from three flat colours and one curved edge. A plum field fills roughly 85% of the canvas beneath a cream band, and its top edge rises, dips to a point at dead centre and rises again — a subtle nod to the valley of an open book. The headline is set in a warm, high-contrast serif at display scale with a single italic word for emphasis, and the lowercase wordmark repeats beneath it in amber at about half the size. No photography, gradients or product UI; all of the visual interest comes from the organic curve, the colour block and typographic scale.
